Class TourPackage

java.lang.Object
TourPackage
Direct Known Subclasses:
AdventureTourPackage
public class TourPackage extends Object
Represents a generic tour package in the Tourism domain. This class serves as the base class in the Single Inheritance demonstration.
Version:
1.0
